title: Burundi | World Coffee Guide
description: The Burundi coffees I like best are bright and sweet, with red fruit and a bergamot edge, a little like a good Earl Grey. Almost all of it is Bourbon from small gardens on steep hills, washed at stations and often sold under the names of the northern provinces, Kayanza and Ngozi. It sits right next to Rwanda, and the two are easy to confuse on a menu.
